XRoboToolkit PC Service minimal runtime

Source: https://github.com/XR-Robotics/XRoboToolkit-PC-Service.git
Upstream source commit reviewed: 85bac4dbc1fd5cef42c74a160d9c30aa3491f122
Upstream/package version: 1.0.0.0
License: Apache-2.0

The platform runtime contains only the headless service executable, its direct
private library closure, setting.ini, and libPXREARobotSDK.so. Demos, Unity,
QML, translations, graphics plugins, development headers, and package-manager
integration are intentionally excluded.
ELF debug information and symbols unnecessary for dynamic linking are removed
with strip --strip-unneeded when the platform tool is available.
Absolute build-machine RPATH/RUNPATH entries are replaced with target-local
`$ORIGIN` paths so the runtime does not reference the vendor build host.

setting.ini is a BXI headless configuration derived from the upstream Linux
configuration. It explicitly binds gRPC to 127.0.0.1:60061 and disables the
vendor file logger; this modification is marked in the file itself.
